description: This file defines the Subordinate class, a data transfer object (DTO) for representing subordinate employees within the reporting module of OrangeHRM. It includes methods for converting employee subordinate data into arrays and retrieving specific fields, with logic to handle reporting methods.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: A DTO class representing subordinate employee data, capable of converting subordinate info into an array and handling specific field retrieval logic, including subordinate's reporting method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Subordinate DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts subordinate employee data into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Retrieves specific field data for an employee item, with custom logic for 'subReportingMethod'.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of fields to getter methods for subordinate employee data.
